Preston, Amon & Efstathiou (2305.09827) find that to reconcile DES Y3 cosmic shear with Planck LCDM, the non-linear suppression needed is weaker than the KiDS-1000 value (A_mod ~ 0.69). It is still more extreme than recent hydrodynamic simulations predict, and it must extend into the mildly non-linear regime, to k ~ 0.2 h/Mpc. The DES Y3 A_mod value itself was not in the text I read (abstract and conclusions), so it remains unsourced.

Correction to the f-004 wording. Amon & Efstathiou (2206.11794) show that suppressing the non-linear power with A_mod~0.69 is sufficient to reconcile KiDS-1000 with Planck LCDM. It is one possible route, not the only one. On mitigation, Siegel et al. (2512.02954) find in their LSST-Y1 mock that an uninformed baryonification model removes the S8 bias but roughly doubles the S8 uncertainty (precision halved). A kSZ+eROSITA-calibrated prior recovers about half of that lost precision.

The HACC Pk-ratio emulator has trained redshifts z = 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0, with 799 k bins. Its design bounds are kappa_w 2-4, e_w 0.2-1.0, M_seed 0.6-2.0, v_kin 0.1-1.2, eps_kin 0.02-1.2, omega_m 0.12-0.155 and sigma_8 0.7-0.9. Predictions were written for maxsupp, maxsupp_lowkin and maxsupp_lowM at z=0, and for fiducial and maxsupp at z=0 and at z=1.

HACC Pk-ratio (P_hydro/P_grav) at z=0 for the strongAGN point (kappa_w=3.0, e_w=1.0, M_seed=1.3, v_kin=1.2, eps_kin=1.2, omega_m=0.14, sigma_8=0.8) is 0.851 at k=5.25, 0.8205 at k=7.01, 0.7946 at k=10.01 and 0.7893 at k=12.55 h/Mpc (the last tabulated k). The curve flattens to a plateau of about 0.789-0.790 for k of about 11.6-12.6 h/Mpc, so there is no resolved upturn: the minimum is at or just beyond k_max of about 12.6 h/Mpc and has a depth of about 21%.

The HACC Pk-ratio emulator k-grid (799 bins) runs from 0.022 to about 12.6 h/Mpc. That answers q-01: the grid reaches 10 h/Mpc but stops at about 12.6 h/Mpc, so the high-k upturn seen in FLAMINGO and OWLS-type runs is not covered. For the strongAGN point the ratio is still decreasing slowly (by less than 0.001 per 0.1 h/Mpc) at the edge.

At k of about 3.7 h/Mpc and z=0, the fiducial point (kappa_w=3, e_w=0.6, v_kin=0.65, eps_kin=0.61) has a Pk-ratio of 0.8984 (std 0.004), against 0.8909 for strongAGN. At k=1.01 the values are 0.9779 (fiducial) and 0.9746 (strongAGN), and at k=3.01 they are 0.9197 and 0.9121. Strong kinetic feedback therefore deepens the suppression by only about 0.3-0.8 percentage points over k=1-3.7 h/Mpc.

Siegel et al. (arXiv:2512.02954) find from joint eROSITA X-ray gas fractions plus SDSS/DESI+ACT kSZ profiles a matter power suppression of 10 +/- 2% at k = 1 h/Mpc, stronger than the fiducial FLAMINGO and BAHAMAS models. HSC-XXL gas fractions prefer 5 +/- 4% at k = 1 h/Mpc.

Grandis et al. (arXiv:2309.02920) use cluster gas and stellar fractions to infer a suppression of 0.042 (+0.012/-0.014) at k = 1 h/Mpc and 0.184 (+0.026/-0.031) at k = 3 h/Mpc. They predict, at 97.5% credibility, that baryons change P(k) by less than 1% for k < 0.37 h/Mpc, and on that basis question whether baryon feedback drives the cosmic-shear vs CMB S8 discrepancy.

Preston, Amon and Efstathiou (arXiv:2305.09827) model P_m = P_L + A_mod (P_NL - P_L). Their KiDS-1000 Paper I value is A_mod ≈ 0.69. For DES Y3 the abstract says only that the required suppression is "not as strong as inferred using KiDS data, but is still more extreme than predictions from recent numerical simulations", and that it must extend to k ~ 0.2 h/Mpc. The DES Y3 numerical A_mod was not in the portion of the text read so far.

Maraio, Hall and Taylor (arXiv:2410.12500) find that for a Euclid-like survey with ell_max = 5000, even multi-parameter baryon models (including HMCode-2020) can bias Omega_m and S8 significantly. A theoretical-error covariance on P(k) reduces this bias to acceptable levels with only a modest increase in parameter variances. The abstract gives no numerical S8 shift.

Answers q-07. Preston, Amon and Efstathiou (arXiv:2305.09827, Eq. 3) find that Planck LCDM is compatible with DES Y3 cosmic shear if non-linear power is suppressed with A_mod = 0.858 +/- 0.052 (no scale cuts, Planck prior on S8 and Omega_m). This is a weaker suppression than the KiDS-1000 value A_mod ≈ 0.69 from Paper I (arXiv:2206.11794).

fGas (cluster gas fraction vs M500c, 3 mass bins) was predicted at z=0 for the fiducial, strongAGN and weakAGN points. The CSVs are written, but their values were not read because the tool budget ran out, so the van Daalen-type pairing of gas fraction with suppression is still open.

For the combined extreme HACC point, suppression weakens strongly from z=0 to z=1. At k=1.013 h/Mpc the ratio rises from 0.9638+/-0.0020 at z=0 to 0.9781+/-0.0018 at z=1, so the suppression drops from 3.6% to 2.2%. At k=3.007 it rises from 0.8698+/-0.0065 to 0.9299+/-0.0055 (13.0% to 7.0%). At k=3.70 it rises from 0.8400+/-0.0076 to 0.9214+/-0.0064 (16.0% to 7.9%).
